in_marathi.name: Anithya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anithya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, the name Anithya means 'immutable' or 'everlasting'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'anitya', which means 'transient' or 'impermanent'. The name embodies the idea of something that never changes, is eternal, and unending.
